The value comes from metrics.ssro.measure.constant.QB5.fidelity, which is the single-shot readout fidelity of the default measure gate. It is 0.9872 with an uncertainty of about 0.0011. QB5 is also the highest under measure_fidelity, at 0.9879. QB9 is second, at 0.9856 for measure and 0.9861 for measure_fidelity. Only 16 of the 24 qubits have SSRO data. The heralded variants rank QB10 first, at 0.9906 for measure and 0.9920 for measure_fidelity. Those variants are post-selected, so I did not use them for the main answer.
